body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 041c526b90640609ea227611f087855c6372af5a -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a safety-tier review because the change affects posted G-code.

- The post now refuses a guide offset on a positioning move before the first cut. It does not thread or cut that section.
- The next vertical section posts normally. The explicit 4-axis refusal stays.
- Issue #1497 permits the refusal to stay when the PR records the missing information. The decision file records that information.
- No golden changed. `nc/sodick-wire/wire_slug_punch.nc` is identical to upstream main. No UI or dependency changed.

Local results: I trial-merged the PR with upstream main `98f093fba91aea1b63cdd1498722ca9f7d73f428`. The merge had no conflicts. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-post --no-run` | Passed |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | Passed: 18 post suites, 146 tests; 12 app suites, 75 tests |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |

I ran two mutations through the post engine. The test source and script copies were outside the tracked tree.

1. Use the upstream post without the new rapid guard: two regression tests fail; three tests pass. The output includes unwanted threading and cutting.
2. Keep the warning but remove `sectionOk = false` from the new guard: the same two tests fail; three tests pass. The output still includes `T91` and `G01`.

The fixed script then passes all five tests. These checks cover both the diagnostic and the cut block.

Requested changes: none.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
